title: Pro-zero cones of the strict completed Koszul tensor augmentation
statement: For a completed coefficient datum and a generating finite list, let beta be any natural strict tensor tower augmentation normalized on the Koszul units and zero on every total summand of nonzero exterior degree as in [lem-weil-pbc-completed-koszul-tensor-quotient-augmentation]. For every unbounded acyclic-tensor K-flat P, the strict tower of mapping cones of beta at P is pro-zero in the derived category of completed module sheaves: for each n there are m >= n and the actual induced cone successor m to n whose image under Q is zero. No assertion about products, Roos fibres or derived limits is made.

source.place: Tag 099M, proof of lemma-naive-completion; More on Algebra, sequence-Koszul-complexes (Tag 091N)

proof.text: Use the Noetherian Koszul augmentation theorem over ULift A, transporting Noetherianity along ULift.ringEquiv. Its specified strict augmentation, diagonal and quotient maps provide algebraic cone transitions which are eventually zero after localization.

Apply finite exact coefficient-cone realization to beta evaluated at the cochain unit. Its exact functor preserves quasi-isomorphisms. The localization universal property carries zero algebraic cone transitions to zero realized cone transitions; naturality of the specified level isomorphisms and cancellation of the source isomorphism give pro-zero for the actual coefficient cone tower.

The finite tensor-cone comparison identifies the actual cone tower at P with the coefficient cone tower followed by tensorLeft P. K-flatness and the signed tensor-cone isomorphism show this functor preserves quasi-isomorphisms. Localization therefore preserves its zero maps. Apply it to the coefficient-cone transition and transport along the tower isomorphism to obtain the required actual transition.

theorem completedKoszulTensorQuotientConeProZero
    (T : Scheme.{t}) {A : Type t} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (r : ℕ) (a : Fin r → A) (ha : Ideal.span (Set.range a) = d.ideal)
    (β : completedKoszulTensorTower T d r a ⟶
      (completedAdicOrdinaryTower T d).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ))
    (hu : ∀ (P : CochainComplex (CompletedAdicModules T d) ℤ) (n : ℕ),
      completedAdicKoszulTensorUnit T d r a P n ≫
        (HomologicalComplex.complexOfFunctorsToFunctorToComplex.map (β.app P)).app (op n) =
          completedQuotientTensorUnit T d P n)
    (hz : ∀ (P : CochainComplex (CompletedAdicModules T d) ℤ) (n : ℕ) (p q : ℤ) (hq : q ≠ 0),
      completedKoszulTensorSummand T d r a P n p q ≫
          ((HomologicalComplex.complexOfFunctorsToFunctorToComplex.map
            (β.app P)).app (op n)).f (p + q) = 0)
    (P : CochainComplex (CompletedAdicModules T d) ℤ)
    (hP : CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R := completedAdicCommRing T d) P) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ (m : ℕ) (h : n ≤ m), DerivedCategory.Q.map
      ((CochainComplex.mappingCone (β.app P)).asFunctor.map (homOfLE h).op) = 0
